answer: Weight must be grown ring by ring. Each key keeps a juniper on the marble roll: one ring per verified epoch, each claimed ring locking 10 POA, two rings minimum to vote. Each epoch a ripple crosses the roll: the key signs the fresh nonce, and lottery-drawn auditors replay one juniper in six, re-deriving each claimed ring. A gap, clone, or shared signature burns the whole backing, zeros the weight, benches the key two epochs. Fakes grow separately: N fakes × 20 POA = 20N POA burned. Limit: honest keys also wait.
